verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents a public API for programmatically managing datasets, queries, triggers, SLOs, environments, and API keys, with a downloadable OpenAPI spec for tooling integration, which directly supports AI-native/agentic control of the product. Missing for 10: a live-hosted OpenAPI/swagger endpoint (probe found 404s on common paths) and independent third-party corroboration of API robustness beyond vendor docs.
